plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the official Salem College 2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog (current edition, catoid=34), Health Humanities Major (BA) program page (poid=912). Salem College publishes major requirements but no official semester sequence for this program (its Print Degree Planner is a blank worksheet), so the plan is collected in requirements_only form as a single block. The recorded total is the major requirement only; the full degree requirements, including the Salem Impact core (published separately in the same catalog), are not itemized here. Per-course credits are the Hour(s) values printed on each course's own official course detail page in the same catalog; the program page itself prints no per-course credits. Prerequisites naming courses outside this plan are disclosed in these notes and are not recorded as plan prerequisites. The catalog states the major requires a minimum of 30 semester hours: a four-course required core and six electives taken from at least three different disciplines, and that no more than four courses may count toward both this major and a second major. The recorded total (30) is core 12 + electives 18, the printed minimum. Cross-listed pairs are listed as printed and counted once per slot: ARTH 170/HHMN 170, ARTH 268/HHMN 268 (HHMN 268's title is garbled as printed, 'Art and Empathy in Renaussance and Bariq' [sic]), ENGL 255/HHMN 255 (one-way statement only, on HHMN 255's detail), ENGL 105/HHMN 105, HIST 248/HHMN 248, and the triple WGSS 215/RELI 215/HHMN 215. Catalog anomalies disclosed, not corrected: HHMN 320's detail states it is cross-listed with RELI 320, but RELI 320 does not exist in this catalog (catalog search returns no matches) and is not listed anywhere in the program; HIST 224/POLI 224 and HIST 241/REST 241 are paired in the program with identical titles and descriptions but neither detail page states a cross-listing; HIST 215/REST 210 are cross-listed both ways but the program page renders their title without the detail headings' punctuation; ARTH 170 prints GenEd 'Art' while HHMN 170 prints 'Arts' for the same course; HIST 282's title is truncated as printed ('Women Healing and Medicine in Early Amer'); HHMN 390's detail prints 'will permission' [sic] and the program notes students may request to count a senior seminar in another of the Humanities or Arts instead. Prerequisites naming courses outside this plan (SPAN 207 for SPAN 208, SPAN 206 for SPAN 211, both elective options) are disclosed on the elective slots and are not recorded.

courses.title: Senior Project in Health Humanities
courses.choice_note: Required of majors in their senior year as printed; the program notes an alternative senior seminar in another of the Humanities or Arts may be requested instead, disclosed in the plan notes.

courses.title: Literary and Narrative Studies
courses.choice_note: Choose one course for the Literary and Narrative Studies core block. All catalog options are printed at 3 Hour(s), in printed order; the four printed course-options are eight codes because each is a cross-listed pair, counted once: ARTH 170/HHMN 170, ARTH 268/HHMN 268, ENGL 255/HHMN 255, ENGL 105/HHMN 105 (see plan notes).

courses.title: Historical Studies and Perspectives
courses.choice_note: Choose one course for the Historical Studies and Perspectives core block. All options are printed at 3 Hour(s), in printed order. HIST 248 / HHMN 248 are a cross-listed pair, counted once. HIST 224's paired code POLI 224 appears only in the elective list, not in this block, as printed.

courses.title: Ethical Studies
courses.choice_note: Choose one course for the Ethical Studies core block. All options are printed at 3 Hour(s), in printed order. WGSS 215 / RELI 215 / HHMN 215 are one triple-cross-listed course, counted once. HHMN 320's stated cross-list partner RELI 320 does not exist in this catalog and is not an option (see plan notes).

courses.title: Health Humanities Elective
courses.choice_note: Choose six courses in total for the elective block, not taken in the core requirements and drawing from at least three disciplines (this is one of the six choice slots). Options listed at the slot's exercised 3 credits, in the catalog's printed order (the elective list is a single flat list, not grouped by discipline). Options in the catalog list at other credits, disclosed not listed as fixed options: CRWR 315 The Art and Act of Revision (4 Hour(s), prerequisite one writing intensive course) and MUSI 220 Special Topics in Music and Health (1-4 Hour(s)); this program prints no rule that each course be taken for 3 or 4 hours, so a completion using MUSI 220 below 3 hours would total under the printed 30-hour minimum, as printed. Prerequisites naming courses outside this plan, disclosed not recorded: SPAN 208 requires SPAN 207 and SPAN 211 requires SPAN 206, neither of which is in this program.
